title: Cell: The Unit of Life
seo_title: Cell Class 11 Biology Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 8)
standard_text: Cell theory and cell as the basic unit of life; structure of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells; plant cell and animal cell; cell envelope, cell membrane, cell wall; cell organelles – structure and function; endomembrane system, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi bodies, lysosomes, vacuoles; mitochondria, ribosomes, plastids, microbodies; cytoskeleton, cilia, flagella, centrioles; nucleus.
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 11 Biology worksheets for NCERT Chapter 8 Cell: The Unit of Life: cell theory, prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, the plasma membrane, cell organelles and their functions, and the nucleus. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: All living things are made of cells; cells come from cells.
key_sub: Each organelle has a job: mitochondria respire, ribosomes make proteins.
body_html:
How to think about it

The cell theory (Schleiden, Schwann, Virchow) says all organisms are made of cells and new cells come from existing cells. Prokaryotic cells (bacteria) have no nuclear membrane and 70S ribosomes; eukaryotic cells have a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles. The plasma membrane is a fluid mosaic of lipids and proteins.

The endomembrane system (ER, Golgi, lysosomes, vacuoles) makes, packs and digests materials. Mitochondria and chloroplasts have their own DNA. Ribosomes, centrioles and the cytoskeleton have no membrane.

Example

Organelle for protein synthesis?

rRNA + protein

Answer: ribosome

Example

Prokaryote ribosomes?

smaller

Answer: 70S

Common mistakes

  • Saying ribosomes have a membrane.
  • Saying animal cells have cell walls.
  • Mixing up cristae and grana.

faq.a: They carry out aerobic respiration and make most of the cell's ATP.

faq.q: What is the fluid mosaic model?
faq.a: The plasma membrane is a fluid lipid bilayer with proteins floating in it, as Singer and Nicolson proposed.
